# Sam's News — conservation — 2026-10-12

## Conservation

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> Global Wildlife Populations Decline 73%, India Reports Conservation Progress
The WWF's 2026 Living Planet Report documents a 73% average decline in monitored wildlife populations since 1970, while India has achieved notable conservation gains across multiple species. Freshwater ecosystems showed the steepest declines at 85%.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>73% average decline in monitored vertebrate populations (1970–2022)</li>
<li>Freshwater wildlife down 85%; terrestrial 69%; marine 59%</li>
<li>Habitat loss identified as most frequent threat, followed by overexploitation</li>
<li>India: tigers 3,682; one-horned rhinos 3,300+; Asiatic lions 891; snow leopards 718</li>
<li>India: 6,324 Ganges river dolphins across 8,507 km surveyed</li>
<li>Vertebrate populations declined average 73% since 1970</li>
<li>Freshwater wildlife down 85%; land species 69%; marine 59%</li>
<li>Regional declines: Latin America/Caribbean 95%, Africa 80%, Europe/Central Asia 23%</li>
<li>Wild tiger populations up 70% since 2010; tuna and green sea turtles recovering</li>
<li>~$58 trillion (2023) of global GDP depends on nature and ecosystem services</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Trump Rollback of Endangered Species Protections Threatens Canadian Wildlife
The president of the United States' Interior Department rescinded the definition of 'harm' under the Endangered Species Act in July 2026, effective September 2026. Canadian experts warn this threatens transboundary species including migratory birds, grizzly bears, and critically endangered killer whales.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Rescission effective September 14, 2026; reverses Supreme Court mid-1990s interpretation</li>
<li>&#x27;Harm&#x27; no longer includes significant habitat changes or degradation</li>
<li>Nearly dozen conservation groups filed lawsuit challenging repeal</li>
<li>Southern resident killer whales critically endangered; population depends on cross-border habitat protection</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-mid" title="Importance 5.5/10" aria-label="Importance 5.5 of 10">5.5</span> NSW Government Halts Environmental Water, Forces Turtle Rescue From Dried Wetland
Environmental water to a NSW wetland was cut after a complaint from a private landholder, forcing a rescue of freshwater turtles before the area dried completely.

### <span class="imp imp-mid" title="Importance 5/10" aria-label="Importance 5 of 10">5</span> Bangladesh Launches Wildlife Commission to Protect Endangered Species and Restore Critical Habitats
Bangladesh has established a new wildlife commission focused on protecting endangered species and restoring critical habitats. The initiative includes efforts to restore tidal flows and strengthen forest protection, including clearing shrimp farms from Sonadia island mangroves to recover these vital coastal ecosystems.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Bangladesh created a dedicated wildlife commission for species protection and habitat restoration</li>
<li>Sonadia island mangrove restoration involves clearing shrimp farms to restore tidal flows</li>
<li>Initiative addresses protection of endangered species across the country</li>
</ul>
